node.title: Rank-eleven rank-flat kernel-shortening router
node.closure: componentwise affine projection and exact flat shortening to the paid rank-at-most-nine family
node.statement: For a high-core-absorbing evaluation rank-flat component of correction dimension 2<=s<=10, let U be the kernel of evaluation on the s+1 flat coordinates. A vertical component costs one slope. On a slope-dominating component, solve in a complement to U; high-core absorption puts every high residual coefficient in U and leaves one affine codeword owner agreeing with the received line on the flat. After translating by that owner, all explanations lie in U and vanish on the flat. Exact locator division shortens to explanation rank dim U<=s-1<=9, which the proved rank-drop theorem pays. The number and aggregate mass of components remain open.
